title: An item that adds a check runs it over the live repository at planning
goal: The /kb-backlog plan step and kb/_self/backlog.md's Plan say that an item adding a check or a gate rule runs it (or a draft of it) over the live repository before the item is committed to a sprint, and puts what it finds, and the files holding it, in the item's touches or in a bug the item depends on, so the check lands green. Answers the SP-ar52y6fk failure: ST-mklj46kq's section-reference check made selfdoc.py check red on main with three dead references, and BG-grwpxhsd was filed and joined to the sprint while landing.
